nom: Dermalogica Futurecode Booster A Damage Correction & Longevity Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report noticeable hydration within just a few days, describing their skin as feeling comfortable and plump rather than tight.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or normal-combination skin, including one already dealing with early signs of aging, found the lightweight texture layered well and did not clog pores, though it did not agree with every combination-skin reviewer.
segments.sensitive: The reviewers who describe their own skin as sensitive, including one with acne scars, report the fragrance-free formula did not irritate them.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report their fine lines, crow's feet or smile lines look softer and their skin feels firmer within one to three weeks of daily use, most describing the change as gradual rather than an overnight transformation.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly describe the serum as quickly and noticeably hydrating, often within days, leaving skin feeling plump and comfortable.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers report the serum calmed persistent redness around their eyes and nostrils with regular use.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers with acne scars or hyperpigmentation report visible fading and a more even tone after a few weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer's skin pilled, felt clogged and broke out slightly even though a friend loved the same product; by contrast, several others, including reviewers who describe their skin as acne-prone, specifically note it did not clog pores or trigger breakouts.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers credit the serum with visibly repairing a compromised skin barrier, describing previously dry, dull skin as refreshed and feeling stronger and less reactive over time.

aspects.libelle: Innovative auto-dropper dispenses the right amount
Applicator takes time to figure out, occasionally malfunctions
Can pill when layered with too much product

extraits.texte: It is not rich enough. Pay a lot of money and don't like the product is enough for a the price

I've only been using this for a few days and my dry skin already feels completely different. The texture feels noticeably smoother, my fine lines look softer, and there's this brightness to my complexion that wasn't there before. I genuinely wasn't expecting results this fast. The hydration is the biggest thing for me though, my skin feels plump and comfortable all day which dry skin girlies know is not easy to achieve. Really impressed so far and excited to see how it builds over time. I like how I can layer this serum and always notice an even tone after application. If you have dry-combination skin, you'll like this. gifted by dermalogica

My friend is absolutely in love with this serum — it works amazing for her skin. But on me, it didn't work out. It pills a lot, especially with other products, and feels like it doesn't fully absorb. I also started noticing clogged pores and small breakouts, which was really disappointing. I think it can work great for some people, just not for my skin. complimentary from dermalogica

I have acne scars on my cheeks, smile lines and lines along my eyes so I was excited to try this serum. The formula is a lightweight, milky serum that instantly hydrates the skin and absorbs into the skin quickly. The applicator is innovative and took some adjusting, but the formula is worth it to learn something new! My acne scars have noticeably faded and the lines along my mouth and eyes have softened a lot. Overall, I am excited for continued use and results. So glad this was offered by Dermalogica!

I've been using this serum for about 10 days, and it's been such an easy step to add into my skincare routine. What stands out most to me is that I've noticed an improvement not only in my skin's overall elasticity, but also in the redness around my eyes and nostrils, which has always bothered me. My skin absorbs it right away, it works really well under makeup, and I'm genuinely excited to see how much more my skin improves over time! gifted by dermalogica

This serum has changed my skin barrier. My skin was feeling dry and looking dull. Using this, my skin looks refreshed and renewed. I use it every evening and my skin is amazing. I would definitely recommend. complimentary from dermalogica

gifted by dermalogica this product was good! I have acne scars and sensitive skin with a few fine lines and this product has been helping with making those lines look less visible. Also this makes my skin look glowy!
